  season: "2627"
format:
  dashboard:
      scrolling: true
      logo: https://anfieldindex.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/AI-Under-Pressure.png
      nav-buttons:
                  - icon: github
                    href: https://github.com/Barts78
                  - icon: linkedin
                    href: https://www.linkedin.com/in/phil-barter-55500122/
                  - icon: twitter
                    href: https://twitter.com/Barts78
                  - icon: bluesky
                    href: https://bsky.app/profile/barts78.bsky.social
      theme:
        - Lux
        - Matchdash_UP_v2.scss
      type: default
      include-in-header:
        text: |
          <style>
          .method-card .card-body { background-color: #FFFFFF !important; color: #1A1A1A !important; }
          .method-card .card-body p, .method-card .card-body li,
          .method-card .card-body strong, .method-card .card-body code { color: #1A1A1A !important; }
          .pp-wrap { background:#FFFAFA; color:#1A1A1A; padding:.5rem; }
          .pp-wrap select { font-size:1rem; padding:.3rem .6rem; border-radius:6px; border:2px solid var(--pp-col); min-width:18rem; }
          .pp-head, .pp-head.html-fill-container { display:flex !important; flex-direction:row !important; flex-wrap:wrap !important; gap:.5rem; margin:.6rem 0; }
          .pp-chip { display:inline-block !important; width:auto !important; flex:0 0 auto !important; background:var(--pp-col); color:var(--pp-txt); border-radius:999px; padding:.15rem .7rem; font-size:.85rem; font-weight:600; }
          .pp-grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(420px, 1fr)); gap:.6rem; }
          .pp-grid img, .cv-img { width:100%; height:auto; display:block; border:1px solid #DDD; }
          .rt-wrap { background:#FFFFFF; color:#1A1A1A; }
          .cv-bar, .cv-bar.html-fill-container { display:flex !important; flex-direction:row !important; flex-wrap:wrap !important; gap:.4rem; margin:.2rem 0 .6rem 0; }
          .cv-btn { flex:0 0 auto !important; border:2px solid var(--pp-col); background:#FFFFFF; color:#1A1A1A; border-radius:6px; padding:.2rem .8rem; font-size:.85rem; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; }
          .cv-btn.active { background:var(--pp-col); color:var(--pp-txt); }
          .cv-note { font-size:.75rem; color:#555; margin:.4rem; }
          </style>
          <script>
          (function () {
            var cur = { view: null, player: null };
            function apply() {
              document.querySelectorAll('.cv-btn').forEach(function (b) {
                b.classList.toggle('active', b.getAttribute('data-view') === cur.view);
              });
              document.querySelectorAll('.cv-panel').forEach(function (p) {
                var pl = p.getAttribute('data-player');
                var show = p.getAttribute('data-view') === cur.view && (!pl || pl === cur.player);
                p.style.display = show ? '' : 'none';
              });
              window.dispatchEvent(new Event('resize'));
            }
            document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
              var b = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('.cv-btn') : null;
              if (!b) return;
              cur.view = b.getAttribute('data-view'); apply();
            });
            document.addEventListener('change', function (e) {
              if (e.target && e.target.id === 'pp-select') { cur.player = e.target.value; apply(); }
            });
            document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
              var b = document.querySelector('.cv-btn'); if (b) cur.view = b.getAttribute('data-view');
              var s = document.getElementById('pp-select'); if (s) cur.player = s.value;
              apply();
            });
          })();
          </script>

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(ggsoccer)
library(ggrepel)
library(patchwork)
library(gt)
library(gtExtras)
library(reactable)
library(htmltools)
library(readxl)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

# ---- settings -------------------------------------------------------------
data_root   <- "~/Documents/Dropbox files/AI LFC data"
db_dir      <- file.path(data_root, "Data Sets/WhoScored/Databases")
Match_Home  <- as.character(params$team)
Competition <- as.character(params$competition)
GameName    <- as.character(params$database)

# the league database first, then the cups ("Label=DatabaseName;..."); a missing one is skipped
parse_dbs <- function(s) {
  s <- trimws(strsplit(as.character(s), ";")[[1]]); s <- s[nzchar(s)]
  if (!length(s)) return(character())
  setNames(trimws(sub("^[^=]*=", "", s)), trimws(sub("=.*$", "", s)))
}
databases <- c(setNames(GameName, Competition), parse_dbs(params$other_databases))

keep_cols <- c("game_name", "Game_date", "TeamName", "playerId", "role", "player_shirt", "type",
               "type/value", "outcomeType/value", "period", "minute", "second", "expandedMinute",
               "x", "y", "finalX", "finalY", "cardType_displayName", "teamColor",
               "Goals", "Own_Goals", "Assists", "TotalShots", "OTShots", "xG", "NPxG", "xGOT", "MyxA",
               "TeamxT", "EPVvalue", "Touches", "PK_Box_Touches", "Final_Third_Touches",
               "Attempted_Passes", "Successful_Passes", "Prog_Passes", "Final_Third_Passes",
               "PK_Box_Passes", "Key_Passes", "Cross_Passes", "Successful_Cross", "Long_Passes",
               "Successful_Long_Passes", "Successful_Carries", "Prog_Carries", "Final_Third_Carries",
               "Dribbles_Total", "Dribbles_Won", "Dispossessed_Total", "Mis_Control",
               "Tackles_Total", "Tackles_Won", "Interceptions_Total", "Recoverys_Total",
               "Clearances_Total", "Aerial_total", "Aerial_Won", "Ground_Duels_Total",
               "Ground_Duels_Won", "Fouls_Conceeded", "Defensive_Action", "BCs")
read_db <- function(name) {
  pq <- file.path(db_dir, paste0(name, ".parquet")); xl <- file.path(db_dir, paste0(name, ".xlsx"))
  d <- if (file.exists(pq) && requireNamespace("arrow", quietly = TRUE)) {
    sch <- arrow::open_dataset(pq)$schema$names
    as.data.frame(arrow::read_parquet(pq, col_select = all_of(intersect(keep_cols, sch))))
  } else if (file.exists(xl)) read_xlsx(xl, guess_max = 100000) else NULL
  if (is.null(d)) return(NULL)
  for (cl in setdiff(keep_cols, names(d))) d[[cl]] <- NA
  d <- d[, keep_cols]
  d[] <- lapply(d, function(v) if (is.factor(v)) as.character(v) else v)
  d$TeamName <- as.character(d$TeamName); d$playerId <- as.character(d$playerId)
  d$game_name <- as.character(d$game_name); d$Game_date <- as.character(d$Game_date)
  d$teamColor <- as.character(d$teamColor); d$role <- as.character(d$role); d$type <- as.character(d$type)
  d$cardType_displayName <- as.character(d$cardType_displayName); d$player_shirt <- as.character(d$player_shirt)
  d
}
loaded <- lapply(databases, read_db)
if (is.null(loaded[[1]])) stop("League database not found: ", databases[[1]])
loaded <- loaded[!vapply(loaded, is.null, logical(1))]
SeasonDB <- bind_rows(lapply(names(loaded), function(cp) mutate(loaded[[cp]], Comp = cp, .before = 1)))
rm(loaded)

# one name per club (WhoScored sometimes gives the long name)
team_alias <- c("Manchester United" = "Man Utd", "Manchester City" = "Man City",
                "Tottenham Hotspur" = "Tottenham", "Newcastle United" = "Newcastle",
                "Brighton & Hove Albion" = "Brighton", "Wolverhampton Wanderers" = "Wolves")
normalise_team <- function(v) { v <- as.character(v); hit <- v %in% names(team_alias); v[hit] <- team_alias[v[hit]]; v }
SeasonDB$TeamName <- normalise_team(SeasonDB$TeamName)
for (nm in names(team_alias)) SeasonDB$game_name <- gsub(nm, team_alias[[nm]], SeasonDB$game_name, fixed = TRUE)
Match_Home <- normalise_team(Match_Home)

# ---- colours: the club's own (most common in its league games) ------------
contrast_text <- function(bg) {
  rgb <- grDevices::col2rgb(bg)[, 1] / 255
  if (sum(rgb * c(0.299, 0.587, 0.114)) > 0.6) "black" else "white"
}
club_cols <- SeasonDB$teamColor[SeasonDB$TeamName == Match_Home & SeasonDB$Comp == Competition]
club_cols <- trimws(club_cols[!is.na(club_cols) & nzchar(trimws(club_cols))])
Color_Home      <- if (length(club_cols)) names(sort(table(club_cols), decreasing = TRUE))[1] else "red4"
Color_Home_Text <- contrast_text(Color_Home)
# percentile shading: pale grey (low) to the club colour (high)
pct_cols   <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(c("#F2F2F2", Color_Home))(5)
pct_colour <- scales::col_numeric(pct_cols, domain = c(0, 100))
tint <- function(p) grDevices::colorRampPalette(c("#FFFFFF", Color_Home))(101)[round(p * 100) + 1]
Color_Dark <- "#3A3A3A"    # second colour on the maps (works with any club colour)
club_vars  <- paste0("--pp-col:", Color_Home, ";--pp-txt:", Color_Home_Text, ";")

# ---- events ----------------------------------------------------------------
num0 <- function(v) coalesce(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(v)), 0)
ev_all <- SeasonDB %>%
  mutate(.row = row_number()) %>%
  filter(num0(period) < 5, !is.na(TeamName)) %>%
  mutate(across(c(Goals:BCs, `type/value`, `outcomeType/value`, expandedMinute, minute, second), num0),
         across(c(x, y, finalX, finalY), ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.x))),
         Goals = ifelse(Own_Goals == 1, 0, Goals),          # own goals are not the player's goals
         Shot = TotalShots == 1 & Own_Goals != 1,
         role = recode(as.character(role), Keeper = "Goalkeeper"),
         game_id = paste(Comp, game_name, Game_date, sep = " | "))
rm(SeasonDB)
if (!Match_Home %in% ev_all$TeamName[ev_all$Comp == Competition]) stop("No ", Competition, " games for '", Match_Home, "'")

# passes received: the next action is by a team-mate after a completed pass
ev_all <- ev_all %>% arrange(game_id, .row) %>% group_by(game_id) %>%
  mutate(Receiver = ifelse(`type/value` %in% c(1, 2) & `outcomeType/value` == 1 &
                             lead(TeamName) == TeamName & lead(playerId) != playerId, lead(playerId), NA_character_)) %>%
  ungroup()

# a player's role and shirt over the whole season (all competitions)
player_role <- ev_all %>% filter(!is.na(playerId), !is.na(role)) %>%
  count(TeamName, playerId, role) %>% group_by(TeamName, playerId) %>%
  slice_max(n, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>% ungroup() %>% select(-n)
player_shirt <- ev_all %>% filter(!is.na(playerId)) %>%
  count(TeamName, playerId, Shirt = suppressWarnings(as.integer(player_shirt))) %>%
  group_by(TeamName, playerId) %>% slice_max(n, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>% ungroup() %>% select(-n)

# ---- metrics: per 90 (or a %), compared with players in the same role ------
metric_def <- tribble(
  ~Metric,                 ~Group,        ~higher_better, ~roles,
  "Goals",                 "Shooting",    TRUE,  "outfield",
  "NPxG",                  "Shooting",    TRUE,  "outfield",
  "Shots",                 "Shooting",    TRUE,  "outfield",
  "Shots on target",       "Shooting",    TRUE,  "outfield",
  "Box touches",           "Shooting",    TRUE,  "outfield",
  "Assists",               "Creating",    TRUE,  "outfield",
  "xA",                    "Creating",    TRUE,  "outfield",
  "Key passes",            "Creating",    TRUE,  "outfield",
  "Passes into box",       "Creating",    TRUE,  "outfield",
  "Crosses completed",     "Creating",    TRUE,  "outfield",
  "Passes completed",      "Passing & carrying", TRUE, "all",
  "Pass %",                "Passing & carrying", TRUE, "all",
  "Progressive passes",    "Passing & carrying", TRUE, "all",
  "Final-third passes",    "Passing & carrying", TRUE, "outfield",
  "Progressive carries",   "Passing & carrying", TRUE, "outfield",
  "Dribbles won",          "Passing & carrying", TRUE, "outfield",
  "EPV added",             "Passing & carrying", TRUE, "all",
  "Ball losses",           "Passing & carrying", FALSE, "outfield",
  "Tackles won",           "Defending",   TRUE,  "outfield",
  "Interceptions",         "Defending",   TRUE,  "outfield",
  "Recoveries",            "Defending",   TRUE,  "all",
  "Clearances",            "Defending",   TRUE,  "outfield",
  "Aerials won",           "Defending",   TRUE,  "outfield",
  "Aerial %",              "Defending",   TRUE,  "outfield",
  "Ground duel %",         "Defending",   TRUE,  "outfield",
  "Fouls",                 "Defending",   FALSE, "outfield",
  "Saves",                 "Goalkeeping", TRUE,  "gk",
  "Goals prevented",       "Goalkeeping", TRUE,  "gk",
  "Save %",                "Goalkeeping", TRUE,  "gk",
  "Claims & punches",      "Goalkeeping", TRUE,  "gk",
  "Sweeper actions",       "Goalkeeping", TRUE,  "gk")
p90 <- function(v, m) ifelse(m > 0, 90 * v / m, NA_real_)
pct <- function(a, b) ifelse(b > 0, 100 * a / b, NA_real_)
pct_rank <- function(v, pool, higher) {
  pool <- pool[!is.na(pool)]
  if (is.na(v) || !length(pool)) return(NA_real_)
  if (!higher) { v <- -v; pool <- -pool }
  round(100 * (sum(pool < v) + 0.5 * sum(pool == v)) / length(pool))
}

# ---- everything for one view (all competitions, or one competition) -------
build_view <- function(ev, label) {
  games_all <- ev %>%
    group_by(game_id, game_name) %>%
    summarise(Date = min(as.Date(as.character(Game_date), tryFormats = c("%d-%m-%Y", "%Y-%m-%d", "%d/%m/%Y"), optional = TRUE)),
              Comp = first(Comp), End = max(expandedMinute), Teams = list(unique(TeamName)), .groups = "drop")
  comp_abbr <- c("Premier League" = "", "Champions League" = "CL ", "League Cup" = "LC ", "FA Cup" = "FAC ")
  team_games <- games_all %>%
    filter(map_lgl(Teams, ~ Match_Home %in% .x)) %>%
    arrange(Date) %>%
    mutate(Game_No = row_number(),
           Opponent = map_chr(Teams, ~ coalesce(setdiff(.x, Match_Home)[1], "?")),
           Venue = ifelse(startsWith(game_name, paste0(Match_Home, " vs")), "H", "A"),
           Opp_Abbr = toupper(substr(gsub("[^A-Za-z]", "", Opponent), 1, 3)),
           Game_Label = paste0(Game_No, ". ", coalesce(unname(comp_abbr[Comp]), ""), Opp_Abbr, " (", Venue, ")"))
  last_date <- max(team_games$Date, na.rm = TRUE)
  view_label <- paste0(Match_Home, " | ", label, " | ", nrow(team_games), " games to ", format(last_date, "%d-%m-%Y"))

  # minutes from the substitution (and red card) events
  apps <- ev %>% filter(!is.na(playerId)) %>% distinct(game_id, TeamName, playerId)
  sub_on  <- ev %>% filter(type == "SubstitutionOn") %>% group_by(game_id, TeamName, playerId) %>%
    summarise(On = min(expandedMinute), .groups = "drop")
  sub_off <- ev %>% filter(type == "SubstitutionOff" | (type == "Card" & cardType_displayName %in% c("Red", "SecondYellow"))) %>%
    group_by(game_id, TeamName, playerId) %>% summarise(Off = min(expandedMinute), .groups = "drop")
  player_games <- apps %>%
    left_join(sub_on, by = c("game_id", "TeamName", "playerId")) %>%
    left_join(sub_off, by = c("game_id", "TeamName", "playerId")) %>%
    left_join(games_all %>% select(game_id, End), by = "game_id") %>%
    mutate(Started = is.na(On), On = coalesce(On, 0), Off = coalesce(Off, End), Minutes = pmax(Off - On, 0))

  # goalkeepers: goals prevented while on the pitch
  opp_sot <- ev %>% filter(Shot, OTShots == 1) %>%
    transmute(game_id, Shooter_Team = TeamName, shot_min = expandedMinute, xGOT, Goals)
  gk_prevented <- player_games %>%
    inner_join(player_role %>% filter(role == "Goalkeeper") %>% select(TeamName, playerId), by = c("TeamName", "playerId")) %>%
    inner_join(opp_sot, by = "game_id", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
    filter(Shooter_Team != TeamName, shot_min >= On, shot_min <= Off) %>%
    group_by(game_id, TeamName, playerId) %>%
    summarise(xGOT_faced = sum(xGOT), Conceded = sum(Goals), SoT_faced = n(), .groups = "drop")

  per_game <- ev %>%
    filter(!is.na(playerId)) %>%
    group_by(game_id, TeamName, playerId) %>%
    summarise(Goals = sum(Goals), Assists = sum(Assists), Shots = sum(Shot), SoT = sum(Shot & OTShots == 1),
              xG = sum(xG[Shot]), NPxG = sum(NPxG[Shot]), xA = sum(MyxA), xT = sum(TeamxT),
              EPV = sum(EPVvalue[`outcomeType/value` == 1]),
              Touches = sum(Touches), Box_Touches = sum(PK_Box_Touches),
              Passes = sum(Attempted_Passes), Passes_Completed = sum(Successful_Passes),
              Prog_Passes = sum(Prog_Passes), Final_Third_Passes = sum(Final_Third_Passes),
              Box_Passes = sum(PK_Box_Passes), Key_Passes = sum(Key_Passes),
              Crosses = sum(Cross_Passes), Crosses_Completed = sum(Successful_Cross),
              Prog_Carries = sum(Prog_Carries), Dribbles = sum(Dribbles_Total), Dribbles_Won = sum(Dribbles_Won),
              Ball_Losses = sum(Dispossessed_Total) + sum(Mis_Control),
              Tackles_Won = sum(Tackles_Won), Interceptions = sum(Interceptions_Total),
              Recoveries = sum(Recoverys_Total), Clearances = sum(Clearances_Total),
              Aerials = sum(Aerial_total), Aerials_Won = sum(Aerial_Won),
              Duels = sum(Ground_Duels_Total), Duels_Won = sum(Ground_Duels_Won),
              Fouls = sum(Fouls_Conceeded), Def_Actions = sum(Defensive_Action),
              Saves = sum(type == "Save"), Claims = sum(type %in% c("Claim", "Punch")),
              Sweeper = sum(type == "KeeperSweeper"),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    right_join(player_games, by = c("game_id", "TeamName", "playerId")) %>%
    left_join(gk_prevented, by = c("game_id", "TeamName", "playerId")) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ coalesce(.x, 0)))

  season <- per_game %>%
    group_by(TeamName, playerId) %>%
    summarise(Apps = n(), Starts = sum(Started), across(c(Minutes, Goals:Sweeper, xGOT_faced, Conceded, SoT_faced), sum),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    left_join(player_role, by = c("TeamName", "playerId")) %>%
    left_join(player_shirt, by = c("TeamName", "playerId")) %>%
    mutate(role = factor(coalesce(role, "Midfielder"), levels = c("Goalkeeper", "Defender", "Midfielder", "Forward")),
           Prevented = xGOT_faced - Conceded)

  season_metrics <- season %>%
    transmute(TeamName, playerId, role, Minutes,
              `Goals` = p90(Goals, Minutes), `NPxG` = p90(NPxG, Minutes), `Shots` = p90(Shots, Minutes),
              `Shots on target` = p90(SoT, Minutes), `Box touches` = p90(Box_Touches, Minutes),
              `Assists` = p90(Assists, Minutes), `xA` = p90(xA, Minutes), `Key passes` = p90(Key_Passes, Minutes),
              `Passes into box` = p90(Box_Passes, Minutes), `Crosses completed` = p90(Crosses_Completed, Minutes),
              `Passes completed` = p90(Passes_Completed, Minutes), `Pass %` = pct(Passes_Completed, Passes),
              `Progressive passes` = p90(Prog_Passes, Minutes), `Final-third passes` = p90(Final_Third_Passes, Minutes),
              `Progressive carries` = p90(Prog_Carries, Minutes), `Dribbles won` = p90(Dribbles_Won, Minutes),
              `EPV added` = p90(EPV, Minutes), `Ball losses` = p90(Ball_Losses, Minutes),
              `Tackles won` = p90(Tackles_Won, Minutes), `Interceptions` = p90(Interceptions, Minutes),
              `Recoveries` = p90(Recoveries, Minutes), `Clearances` = p90(Clearances, Minutes),
              `Aerials won` = p90(Aerials_Won, Minutes), `Aerial %` = pct(Aerials_Won, Aerials),
              `Ground duel %` = pct(Duels_Won, Duels), `Fouls` = p90(Fouls, Minutes),
              `Saves` = p90(Saves, Minutes), `Goals prevented` = p90(Prevented, Minutes),
              `Save %` = pct(SoT_faced - Conceded, SoT_faced), `Claims & punches` = p90(Claims, Minutes),
              `Sweeper actions` = p90(Sweeper, Minutes)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-c(TeamName, playerId, role, Minutes), names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value") %>%
    left_join(metric_def, by = "Metric") %>%
    filter(roles == "all" | (roles == "gk") == (role == "Goalkeeper"))

  # peers: same role, in this view's games, with enough minutes for per-90 numbers to mean something
  max_team_games <- max(table(unlist(games_all$Teams)))
  min_minutes <- max(90, round(0.25 * 90 * max_team_games))
  peers <- season_metrics %>% filter(Minutes >= min_minutes, !is.na(Value))
  season_metrics <- season_metrics %>%
    group_by(role, Metric) %>%
    mutate(Percentile = vapply(seq_along(Value), function(i)
                          pct_rank(Value[i], peers$Value[peers$role == role[1] & peers$Metric == Metric[1]], higher_better[1]),
                          numeric(1))) %>%
    ungroup()
  n_peers <- peers %>% distinct(role, TeamName, playerId) %>% count(role)

  squad <- season %>% filter(TeamName == Match_Home) %>% arrange(role, desc(Minutes))
  list(label = label, id = gsub("[^a-z0-9]+", "-", tolower(label)), view_label = view_label,
       team_games = team_games, per_game = per_game, season = season, season_metrics = season_metrics,
       squad = squad, squad_metrics = season_metrics %>% filter(TeamName == Match_Home),
       pairs = ev %>% filter(TeamName == Match_Home, !is.na(Receiver)) %>% count(Passer = playerId, Receiver, name = "Passes"),
       ev_club = ev %>% filter(TeamName == Match_Home),
       min_minutes = min_minutes, n_peers = n_peers, n_teams = n_distinct(unlist(games_all$Teams)))
}

club_comps <- intersect(names(databases), unique(ev_all$Comp[ev_all$TeamName == Match_Home]))
views <- c(list(build_view(ev_all, "All competitions")),
           lapply(club_comps, function(cp) build_view(ev_all %>% filter(Comp == cp), cp)))
if (length(club_comps) == 1) views <- views[2]      # league only: no need for an "all" view
views[[1]]$first <- TRUE
names(views) <- vapply(views, `[[`, "", "id")
V_all <- views[[1]]
Season_Label <- V_all$view_label

# ---- shared plot bits -----------------------------------------------------
My_caption <- "X @Barts78 | Bluesky @barts78 | GitHub Barts78 | Data: Opta"
theme_pp <- function() {
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
    theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "snow", colour = NA),
          panel.background = element_rect(fill = "snow", colour = NA),
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 7.5, colour = "grey30"),
          plot.caption = element_text(size = 6, colour = "grey40"),
          legend.position = "top", legend.text = element_text(size = 7), legend.title = element_text(size = 7))
}
pitch <- function() list(annotate_pitch(dimensions = pitch_opta, fill = "#E5E5E5", colour = "#454545"),
                         theme_pitch(), coord_flip(xlim = c(0, 100), ylim = c(100, 0)))
fig_dir <- function() {
  d <- knitr::opts_current$get("fig.path")
  if (is.null(d) || !nzchar(d)) d <- "figure-html/"
  d
}
save_fig <- function(p, stub, width, height, dpi = 150) {
  f <- paste0(fig_dir(), stub, ".png")
  dir.create(dirname(f), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  suppressWarnings(suppressMessages(ggsave(f, p, width = width, height = height, dpi = dpi, bg = "snow")))
  f
}
img_tag <- function(f) if (is.na(f)) p(class = "cv-note", "Not enough data for this chart.") else tags$img(src = f, class = "cv-img", loading = "lazy")
# one raw-HTML block with no blank lines (a blank line would end Quarto's HTML block)
as_block <- function(tags) {
  rt <- htmltools::renderTags(tags)
  htmltools::attachDependencies(htmltools::HTML(gsub("\n[[:space:]]*\n", "\n", rt$html)), rt$dependencies)
}
# competition buttons (all cards on the page switch together) and one panel per view
view_block <- function(make, extra = NULL) {
  bar <- if (length(views) > 1) div(class = "cv-bar", lapply(views, function(v)
    tags$button(class = paste("cv-btn", if (isTRUE(v$first)) "active"), `data-view` = v$id, v$label)))
  panels <- lapply(views, function(v) div(class = "cv-panel", `data-view` = v$id,
                                          style = if (!isTRUE(v$first)) "display:none;", make(v)))
  as_block(div(style = club_vars, extra, bar, panels))
}
short_name <- function(v) { p <- strsplit(v, " "); vapply(p, function(z) if (length(z) > 1) paste(substr(z[1], 1, 1), paste(z[-1], collapse = " "), sep = ". ") else z, "") }
f1 <- function(v) ifelse(is.na(v), "-", format(round(v, 2), nsmall = 2))
stub <- function(x) gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "-", iconv(x, to = "ASCII//TRANSLIT"))
pct_cell <- function(p, low_minutes = FALSE) {
  if (low_minutes || is.na(p)) return(list(color = "#999999"))
  list(background = pct_colour(p), color = if (p >= 70) Color_Home_Text else "#1A1A1A", fontWeight = if (p >= 80) 600 else 400)
}
```

```{r}
#| title: Squad Table (search, sort; shading = percentile against players in the same role)

sq_cols <- c("NPxG", "xA", "Shots", "Key passes", "Progressive passes", "Progressive carries",
             "EPV added", "Tackles won", "Interceptions", "Recoveries", "Aerials won", "Pass %")
squad_table <- function(v) {
  sq_val <- v$squad_metrics %>% filter(Metric %in% sq_cols) %>%
    select(playerId, Metric, Value) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = Metric, values_from = Value)
  sq_pct <- v$squad_metrics %>% filter(Metric %in% sq_cols) %>%
    select(playerId, Metric, Percentile) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = Metric, values_from = Percentile)
  sq <- v$squad %>%
    transmute(Shirt, Player = playerId, Role = as.character(role), Apps, Starts, Mins = round(Minutes),
              G = Goals, A = Assists, `xG tot` = round(xG, 2), `xA tot` = round(xA, 2)) %>%
    left_join(sq_val, by = c("Player" = "playerId")) %>%
    select(Shirt, Player, Role, Apps, Starts, Mins, G, A, `xG tot`, `xA tot`, any_of(sq_cols))
  pc <- intersect(sq_cols, names(sq))
  col_defs <- c(
    list(Player = colDef(minWidth = 160, sticky = "left", style = list(fontWeight = 600)),
         Shirt = colDef(name = "#", width = 45), Role = colDef(minWidth = 110),
         Apps = colDef(width = 60), Starts = colDef(width = 65), Mins = colDef(width = 65),
         G = colDef(width = 45), A = colDef(width = 45),
         `xG tot` = colDef(name = "xG", width = 60), `xA tot` = colDef(name = "xA", width = 60)),
    setNames(lapply(pc, function(cl) {
      force(cl)
      colDef(name = paste0(cl, ifelse(cl == "Pass %", "", " /90")), minWidth = 95, na = "-",
             format = colFormat(digits = ifelse(cl == "Pass %", 1, 2)),
             style = function(value, index) pct_cell(sq_pct[[cl]][match(sq$Player[index], sq_pct$playerId)],
                                                     sq$Mins[index] < v$min_minutes))
    }), pc))
  div(class = "rt-wrap",
    reactable(sq, columns = col_defs, searchable = TRUE, striped = TRUE, highlight = TRUE, compact = TRUE,
              defaultPageSize = 40, defaultSorted = list(Mins = "desc"),
              theme = reactableTheme(headerStyle = list(background = Color_Home, color = Color_Home_Text))),
    p(class = "cv-note",
      paste0(v$view_label, ". Per-90 shading: percentile against players in the same role in ", v$label, " (",
             v$n_teams, " clubs) with ", v$min_minutes, "+ minutes; darker = higher, grey text = too few minutes. ",
             "Minutes from the substitution and red-card events.")))
}
view_block(squad_table)
```

```{r}
#| title: Minutes by Game

minutes_plot <- function(v) {
  mg <- v$per_game %>% filter(TeamName == Match_Home) %>%
    left_join(v$team_games %>% select(game_id, Game_No, Game_Label), by = "game_id") %>%
    left_join(v$squad %>% select(playerId, role), by = "playerId")
  ord <- v$squad %>% arrange(role, Minutes) %>% pull(playerId)
  role_short <- c(Goalkeeper = "GK", Defender = "DEF", Midfielder = "MID", Forward = "FWD")
  mg <- mg %>% mutate(role = factor(role_short[as.character(role)], levels = role_short),
                      Player = factor(playerId, levels = ord),
                      Game_Label = factor(Game_Label, levels = v$team_games$Game_Label))
  ggplot(mg, aes(Game_Label, Player)) +
    geom_tile(aes(fill = Minutes), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_text(aes(label = round(Minutes), fontface = ifelse(Started, "bold", "italic")), size = 2.3,
              colour = ifelse(mg$Minutes > 55, Color_Home_Text, "black")) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "#F2F2F2", high = Color_Home, limits = c(0, NA), name = "Minutes") +
    facet_grid(role ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
    labs(title = paste0(Match_Home, " Minutes by Game"),
         subtitle = paste0(v$view_label, " | bold = started, italic = came on"),
         x = NULL, y = NULL, caption = My_caption) +
    theme_pp() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 6.5), axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
          panel.grid = element_blank(), strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", colour = Color_Home_Text),
          strip.background = element_rect(fill = Color_Home, colour = NA))
}
view_block(function(v) {
  w <- max(8, min(16, 4 + 0.35 * nrow(v$team_games)))
  img_tag(tryCatch(save_fig(minutes_plot(v), paste0("minutes-", v$id), w, 7, dpi = 170), error = function(e) NA))
})
```

```{r}
#| include: false
# percentile chart, game-by-game chart and four pitch maps for every squad player, per view

percentile_plot <- function(v, pid) {
  d <- v$squad_metrics %>% filter(playerId == pid) %>%
    mutate(Metric = factor(Metric, levels = rev(metric_def$Metric)),
           Group = factor(Group, levels = unique(metric_def$Group)),
           lab = ifelse(Metric %in% c("Pass %", "Aerial %", "Ground duel %", "Save %"),
                        paste0(round(Value, 1), "%"), format(round(Value, 2), nsmall = 2)))
  role <- as.character(d$role[1]); mins <- round(d$Minutes[1])
  low <- mins < v$min_minutes
  np <- v$n_peers$n[v$n_peers$role == role]; if (!length(np)) np <- 0
  ggplot(d, aes(y = Metric)) +
    geom_col(aes(x = 100), fill = "grey92", width = 0.75) +
    geom_col(aes(x = Percentile, fill = Percentile), width = 0.75, colour = "#454545", linewidth = 0.2) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 50, colour = "grey50", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_text(aes(x = 101, label = lab), hjust = 0, size = 2.4) +
    geom_text(aes(x = pmax(Percentile, 0) - 1, label = Percentile,
                  colour = ifelse(coalesce(Percentile, 0) >= 70, "dark", "light")), hjust = 1, size = 2.2) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(dark = Color_Home_Text, light = "black"), guide = "none") +
    scale_fill_gradientn(colours = pct_cols, limits = c(0, 100), guide = "none") +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 118), breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    facet_grid(Group ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
    labs(title = paste0(pid, " | Percentiles vs ", role, "s (", v$label, ")"),
         subtitle = paste0(v$view_label, " | ", mins, " mins | per 90 unless %; bar = percentile against ",
                           np, " ", tolower(role), "s with ", v$min_minutes, "+ mins",
                           if (low) " | FEW MINUTES: read with care" else ""),
         x = "Percentile (right of the dashed line = above the median)", y = NULL, caption = My_caption) +
    theme_pp() +
    theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", colour = Color_Home_Text, size = 7),
          strip.background = element_rect(fill = Color_Home, colour = NA),
          panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
}

trend_plot <- function(v, pid) {
  d <- v$per_game %>% filter(TeamName == Match_Home, playerId == pid) %>%
    right_join(v$team_games %>% select(game_id, Game_No, Game_Label), by = "game_id") %>%
    mutate(Minutes = coalesce(Minutes, 0), Game_Label = factor(Game_Label, levels = v$team_games$Game_Label))
  long <- d %>% select(Game_Label, xG, xA) %>% pivot_longer(-Game_Label) %>% mutate(value = coalesce(value, 0))
  ymax <- max(0.5, max(coalesce(d$xG, 0) + coalesce(d$xA, 0)))
  ggplot() +
    geom_col(data = d, aes(Game_Label, ymax * Minutes / 100), fill = "grey90", width = 0.9) +
    geom_col(data = long, aes(Game_Label, value, fill = name), width = 0.55, colour = "#454545", linewidth = 0.2) +
    geom_point(data = d %>% filter(coalesce(Goals, 0) > 0), aes(Game_Label, ymax * 1.08), shape = 21, fill = "white", size = 2.6) +
    geom_text(data = d %>% filter(coalesce(Goals, 0) > 0), aes(Game_Label, ymax * 1.08, label = Goals), size = 2) +
    geom_text(data = d, aes(Game_Label, -ymax * 0.05, label = round(Minutes)), size = 2, colour = "grey40") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(xG = Color_Home, xA = Color_Dark), name = NULL) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.08, 0.05))) +
    labs(title = paste0(pid, " | Game by Game"),
         subtitle = "Bars = xG and xA, grey background = minutes (number under each game), white dot = goals",
         x = NULL, y = "xG + xA", caption = My_caption) +
    theme_pp() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 6))
}

pitch_plot <- function(v, pid) {
  d <- v$ev_club %>% filter(playerId == pid)
  t <- d %>% filter(Touches == 1, !is.na(x))
  p_touch <- ggplot(t, aes(x, y)) + pitch() +
    { if (nrow(t) >= 10) stat_density_2d(aes(fill = after_stat(level)), geom = "polygon", alpha = 0.55, bins = 8) } +
    geom_point(size = 0.5, alpha = 0.35, colour = "#454545") +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "#FFFFFF", high = Color_Home, guide = "none") +
    labs(title = paste0("Touches (", nrow(t), ")"))
  s <- d %>% filter(Shot, !is.na(x)) %>% mutate(Outcome = ifelse(Goals == 1, "Goal", ifelse(OTShots == 1, "On target", "Off target / blocked")))
  p_shot <- ggplot(s, aes(x, y)) + pitch() +
    geom_point(aes(size = xG, fill = Outcome), shape = 21, colour = "black", alpha = 0.85) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(Goal = Color_Home, `On target` = Color_Dark, `Off target / blocked` = "grey80"), name = NULL, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(1, 6), limits = c(0, 1), guide = "none") +
    labs(title = paste0("Shots (", nrow(s), ", ", f1(sum(s$xG)), " xG)")) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.text = element_text(size = 6))
  pp <- d %>% filter(`type/value` %in% c(1, 2), `outcomeType/value` == 1, !is.na(finalX),
                     Prog_Passes == 1 | Key_Passes == 1 | PK_Box_Passes == 1) %>%
    mutate(Kind = ifelse(Key_Passes == 1, "Key pass", "Progressive / into box"))
  p_pass <- ggplot(pp) + pitch() +
    geom_segment(aes(x = x, y = y, xend = finalX, yend = finalY, colour = Kind),
                 arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.08, "cm")), linewidth = 0.35, alpha = 0.8) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(`Key pass` = Color_Home, `Progressive / into box` = Color_Dark), name = NULL) +
    labs(title = paste0("Progressive, box and key passes (", nrow(pp), ")")) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.text = element_text(size = 6))
  da <- d %>% filter(!is.na(x), Tackles_Won == 1 | Interceptions_Total == 1 | Recoverys_Total == 1 |
                       Clearances_Total == 1 | Aerial_Won == 1) %>%
    mutate(Action = case_when(Tackles_Won == 1 ~ "Tackle won", Interceptions_Total == 1 ~ "Interception",
                              Aerial_Won == 1 ~ "Aerial won", Clearances_Total == 1 ~ "Clearance", TRUE ~ "Recovery"))
  p_def <- ggplot(da, aes(x, y)) + pitch() +
    geom_point(aes(fill = Action), shape = 21, colour = "black", size = 1.6, alpha = 0.85) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(`Tackle won` = Color_Home, Interception = Color_Dark, `Aerial won` = tint(0.45),
                                 Clearance = "grey60", Recovery = "white"), name = NULL) +
    labs(title = paste0("Defensive actions (", nrow(da), ")")) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.text = element_text(size = 6))
  (p_touch | p_shot | p_pass | p_def) +
    plot_annotation(title = paste0(pid, " | Maps (", v$label, ")"),
                    subtitle = paste0(v$view_label, " | attacking upwards"), caption = My_caption,
                    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
                                  plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 7.5, colour = "grey30"),
                                  plot.caption = element_text(size = 6, colour = "grey40"))) &
    theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "snow", colour = NA),
          plot.title = element_text(size = 8.5, face = "bold"))
}
```

```{r}
profile_players <- V_all$squad %>% filter(Minutes > 0) %>% arrange(role, desc(Minutes))
```

```{r}
#| title: Who Passes to Whom

pass_matrix <- function(v) {
  sq <- v$squad
  gk_top <- sq %>% filter(role == "Goalkeeper") %>% slice_max(Minutes, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
  top_pl <- bind_rows(gk_top, sq %>% filter(role != "Goalkeeper")) %>%
    slice_max(Minutes, n = 16, with_ties = FALSE) %>% arrange(role, desc(Minutes)) %>% pull(playerId)
  pm <- v$pairs %>% filter(Passer %in% top_pl, Receiver %in% top_pl) %>%
    mutate(Passer = factor(short_name(Passer), levels = rev(short_name(top_pl))),
           Receiver = factor(short_name(Receiver), levels = short_name(top_pl)))
  ggplot(pm, aes(Receiver, Passer, fill = Passes)) +
    geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_text(aes(label = Passes), size = 2.3, colour = ifelse(pm$Passes > 0.55 * max(pm$Passes), Color_Home_Text, "black")) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "#F2F2F2", high = Color_Home, name = "Completed passes") +
    labs(title = paste0(Match_Home, ": Who Passes to Whom"),
         subtitle = paste0(v$view_label, " | completed passes from the row player to the column player (top 16 by minutes)"),
         x = "Receiver", y = "Passer", caption = My_caption) +
    theme_pp() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 7), axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
          panel.grid = element_blank())
}
view_block(function(v) img_tag(tryCatch(save_fig(pass_matrix(v), paste0("passmatrix-", v$id), 10, 8.5, dpi = 170), error = function(e) NA)))
```

```{r}
#| title: Every Player (search a name or club, filter a column, sort)

lf_cols <- c("Goals", "NPxG", "xA", "Shots", "Key passes", "Progressive passes", "Progressive carries",
             "Dribbles won", "EPV added", "Tackles won", "Interceptions", "Recoveries", "Aerials won",
             "Pass %", "Goals prevented", "Saves")
finder_table <- function(v) {
  lf_long <- v$season_metrics %>% filter(Minutes >= v$min_minutes, Metric %in% lf_cols)
  lf_val <- lf_long %>% select(TeamName, playerId, Metric, Value) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = Metric, values_from = Value)
  lf_pct <- lf_long %>% select(TeamName, playerId, Metric, Percentile) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = Metric, values_from = Percentile)
  lf <- v$season %>% filter(Minutes >= v$min_minutes) %>%
    transmute(Player = playerId, Club = TeamName, Role = as.character(role), Apps, Mins = round(Minutes)) %>%
    left_join(lf_val, by = c("Player" = "playerId", "Club" = "TeamName")) %>%
    select(Player, Club, Role, Apps, Mins, any_of(lf_cols))
  key <- paste(lf$Player, lf$Club); pkey <- paste(lf_pct$playerId, lf_pct$TeamName)
  pc <- intersect(lf_cols, names(lf))
  lf_defs <- c(
    list(Player = colDef(minWidth = 160, sticky = "left", style = function(value, index)
           if (lf$Club[index] == Match_Home) list(fontWeight = 700, color = Color_Home) else NULL),
         Club = colDef(minWidth = 140, filterable = TRUE), Role = colDef(minWidth = 110, filterable = TRUE),
         Apps = colDef(width = 60), Mins = colDef(width = 65)),
    setNames(lapply(pc, function(cl) {
      force(cl)
      colDef(name = paste0(cl, ifelse(cl == "Pass %", "", " /90")), minWidth = 95, na = "-",
             format = colFormat(digits = ifelse(cl == "Pass %", 1, 2)),
             style = function(value, index) {
               p <- lf_pct[[cl]][match(key[index], pkey)]
               if (is.na(p)) NULL else pct_cell(p)
             })
    }), pc))
  div(class = "rt-wrap",
    reactable(lf, columns = lf_defs, searchable = TRUE, striped = TRUE, highlight = TRUE, compact = TRUE,
              defaultPageSize = 25, defaultSorted = list(NPxG = "desc"),
              theme = reactableTheme(headerStyle = list(background = Color_Home, color = Color_Home_Text))),
    p(class = "cv-note",
      paste0(v$label, ": players with ", v$min_minutes, "+ minutes (", v$n_teams, " clubs). ",
             "Shading = percentile within the player's role (darker = higher). ", Match_Home, " players in bold.")))
}
view_block(finder_table)
```

# Methodology

## Row

::: {.card .method-card title="How these numbers are worked out"}
- **Competitions**: the buttons switch every table and chart on a page between all competitions and each competition the club has played in (Premier League, Champions League, League Cup, FA Cup when its database exists). Percentiles always compare with players in the same view: in the Champions League view that means every Champions League player.
- **Minutes** come from the events: a player who started is on from minute 0; a substitute from his SubstitutionOn event; a player is off at his SubstitutionOff event or a red card, otherwise at the end of the game (stoppage time included). Penalty shoot-outs are left out.
- **Per 90** = total / minutes x 90. **Percentiles** compare a player with every player in the same role (Goalkeeper, Defender, Midfielder, Forward; the role a player is listed in most) who has enough minutes in that view (a quarter of the most games any club has played there, at least 90 minutes). 50 = median; for ball losses and fouls lower is better, so a high percentile means fewer. Shading runs from pale grey (low) to the club colour (high).
- **Goals** leave out own goals. **xG / NPxG / xGOT** are FotMob's, joined to the Opta events. **xA** and **EPV added** are the pipeline's (EPV added counts successful actions only).
- **Goals prevented** (goalkeepers) = xGOT of shots on target faced while on the pitch minus goals conceded from them (own goals left out). **Save %** = shots on target faced that were not goals.
- **Passing pairs**: a completed pass where the next action in the data is by a team-mate is counted as a pass to that team-mate.
- Data: Opta (WhoScored), FotMob shots. Built by the Under Pressure pipeline.
:::
